First time? Set up your upload access
  1. Open GitHub’s fine-grained token settings in your own account.
  2. Choose resource owner tkjewelrytop-lab and select only friendshipLSKC-forever.
  3. Under repository permissions, set Contents → Read and write. Choose an expiry date.
  4. Create the token, copy it, and paste it above. You don’t need to send it to anyone.
